name: Tutoring Center
description: Peer tutors for most first- and second-year courses. Drop in with your own work; no appointment needed.

name: Campus Recreation
description: Runs intramurals, fitness classes and open gym hours for every skill level.

name: Career Services
description: Helps students with resumes, interviews and internship searches, and hosts the campus career fairs.

name: Robotics Club
description: Students who design, build and program robots for campus showcases and regional competitions. New members learn on club kits.

name: Spoken Word Society
description: Poets and storytellers who write, workshop and perform together at monthly open mics.

name: ACM Student Chapter
description: The student computing chapter: coding nights, tech talks and programming contest practice.

name: University Library
description: Research help, study spaces and workshops on finding and citing sources.

name: Society of Women Engineers
description: Supports women in engineering and computing through mentoring, panels and industry visits.

name: Ceramics Guild
description: Hand-building and wheel-throwing sessions in the student center studio. Clay and glazes provided.

name: Drone Club
description: Builds, repairs and flies small drones, with safety training before the first flight.

name: Student Activities Board
description: Plans free weekly events on campus, from game nights to concerts.

name: Art Club
description: A relaxed studio night for painting and drawing. Beginners welcome; supplies on hand.

name: Math Tutoring Lab
description: Walk-in help for algebra through calculus and review sessions before exams.

name: Student Government Association
description: Elected students who represent the student body and host community events.

name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers
description: Builds community for Hispanic students in STEM through career prep, mentoring and service.

name: International Student Association
description: Brings students from every country together through cultural nights, food and conversation.

name: College of Engineering
description: The college office for engineering programs, advising and senior design showcases.

name: Film Society
description: Screens student films and classics, followed by discussion with the filmmakers when they can come.

name: Green Owls
description: Students working on campus sustainability: recycling drives, garden days and energy projects.

name: Game Development Club
description: Makes small games together, from first prototypes to finished jam entries. All skill levels and roles welcome.

name: Residence Life
description: Supports students living on campus with housing information and hall events.
